data.title: Tranexamic Acid During Prehospital Transport in Patients at Risk for Hemorrhage After Injury A Double-blind, Placebo-Controlled, Randomized Clinical Trial
data.author: Guyette

available_outcomes.name: 30-day all-cause mortality
available_outcomes.source_quote: The primary outcome for the trial was 30-day mortality... At 30 days after randomization, 36 deaths (8%) had occurred in the tranexamic acid intervention arm and 45 deaths (10%) in the placebo arm... the intention-to-treat study cohort comprised a total of 903 patients; there were 447 in the tranexamic acid arm and 456 in the placebo arm.

quotes.randomization: We generated a 1:1:1:1 ratio random allocation sequence with a block size of 12 using a computer random-number generator. We placed sealed drug kits on each participating ambulance or aircraft according to the allocation sequence... Randomization occurred with kit opening.
quotes.deviations: The STAAMP study was a phase 3, multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomized clinical trial... blinded for the prehospital and in-hospital phase interventions... prehospital teams delivered the assigned prehospital infusion in 887 of the 903 patients (98%).
quotes.missingData: The primary outcome was available in 894 patients (99%)... multiple imputation for the 9 patients missing the primary outcome... Sensitivity analysis assuming all patients with missing 30-day mortality outcomes were alive demonstrated similar results.
quotes.measurement: The primary outcome for the trial was 30-day mortality. Mortality in the 7 prespecified subgroups is depicted...
quotes.reporting: The trial protocol can be found in Supplement 1... ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT02086500... Prespecified secondary outcomes and planned secondary analyses...
